newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize up as rain chokes supply.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize up as rain chokes supply.

text.p: Argentine maize at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange was higher for delivery to most ports midsession Monday as rain choked supply, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price for delivery to Quequen, Bahia Blanca and Rosario rose $2 to $108, $109 and $110 respectively. But traders said the heavy rain might ironically cool off the market in coming days as it will grant time to clear out over-burdened port storage space. Rain also pushed up Rosario FAS elevator soybeans $2 to $292 and Rosario sunflower seed $3 to $225. Some export buying pushed Quequen wheat up $2 to $160.
